name: Elemental Prince
original_name: エレメンタルプリンス
source:
You lived an unchanging life.
One day you are suddenly swept up by a massive wave that hits your classroom after school.
By the time you came to, your surroundings had completely changed…and elemental spirits appeared before you.
Your new goal after wandering into the Spirit World is to borrow the strength of the spirits to return to the Human World.
What will be your fate?!
